name: rosenbrock_n5_hybrid
title: 5D Hybrid Rosenbrock Target Distribution from Pagani et al. (2022)
description: Synthetic dataset specifying a 5-dimensional hybrid target space (n1 = 3, n2 = 2) with parameters a = 0.05 and b = 5.0. Following the methodology of Pagani et al. (2022), this configuration simultaneously adds an extra block and increases the variables within those blocks to capture the effects that an increase in the dimension of the state space has on the sampling algorithm.
